whenToUse: A split-screen sign-in that tells the product story beside the form.
Products offering Google/Microsoft SSO and an email-first password flow.
avoidWhen: Enterprise SSO domain discovery — use auth-sso-01.
a11y: Story chapters are a tablist/tab/tabpanel with arrow-key handling.
Email uses autocomplete="username" and the password step autocomplete="current-password".
